notes:
WIN ($WIN): a "last buyer wins" game on a Uniswap v4 WIN/IMD pool.

TOKEN. WinToken: plain fixed-supply ERC-20, no constructor arguments, mints 1,000,000,000e18 once to its deployer. No owner, mint, pause, blocklist, transfer fee or upgrade path.

HOOK. WinGameHook(IPoolManager $poolManager, address $token). No owner, no setters, no DELEGATECALL/SELFDESTRUCT. getHookPermissions returns exactly the five flags listed (address bits 0x20CC). beforeInitialize is PoolManager-only, binds the hook to one pool pairing $token with one 18-decimal currency (IMD is read from the PoolKey), accepts LP fee 500/3000/10000 only, refuses a second pool, and refuses a starting price more than 300 ticks from the briefed one for the ordering it sees (WrongStartingPrice). pool.fee 3000 / tickSpacing 60 is the real LP fee; the hook fee is separate.

INITIAL PRICE - ORDERING. 2500 IMD market cap = 2.5e-6 IMD per WIN, snapped to tick |129000| (2499.66 IMD). The value written, 125262255113908064987203232 = getSqrtPriceAtTick(-129000) = launchSqrtPriceX96(true), is right when WIN sorts below IMD (currency0). If WIN sorts above IMD the hook expects 50111677533496076234078224273595 (tick +129000) and reverts initialization with the value written here, so the launch fails loudly rather than opening a mispriced pool. The deployer must either pin WIN's address below IMD or use the ordering's value. WIN-only range: [-128940, 887220] as currency0, [-887220, 128940] as currency1.

HOOK FEE. Always in IMD, for all four swap shapes: 50% at initialization, linear to 3% over 30 minutes (brief's curve kept). 90% to the bank, 10% to teamOwed; claimTeamFees() (callable by anyone) pays only the constant wallet 0x611F08c7226591708B5F53F29BF53f3830D54511. Fees are minted as ERC-6909 claims, so the first buy works while the manager holds no IMD; payouts burn and take inside the hook's own unlock. The bank starts empty and leaves only as prizes.

GAME. Qualifying buy: gross IMD >= minimumBuy() = max(8.5 IMD, 20% of next prize) x 1.05^n (n = qualifying buys this round, reset each round). It sets the leader and deadline = now + 10 min; round 1 cannot end before launch + 3 h and pays 20% of the bank, later rounds 5%, the rest stays. Sells never touch leader or timer. settle() is open to anyone after expiry and always closes the round: the prize is pushed, or left in unclaimedPrize (claimPrize) if IMD refuses the winner. A buy after expiry first closes the round for its real leader (end-of-round snipe defence). Buyer = hookData (abi.encode(buyer, mustLead), abi.encode(buyer) or 20 packed bytes), else the router's msgSender(), else tx.origin. mustLead=true reverts a buy that misses the minimum at execution. Views: gameState, bankBalance, nextPrize, minimumBuy, leader, timeLeft, roundNumber, pastWinners, pendingPrize.

KNOWN LIMITS. Exact-input buys and exact-output sells that would fill partially revert. Sells need a prior buy to put IMD in the single-sided pool. IMD must be a plain 18-decimal ERC-20. Block stuffing is deterred economically only (REVIEW E10, requester decision; an absolute prize cap is recommended once the chain is fixed).

OPEN. Tests use their own PoolManager and mock IMD in both orderings; a rehearsal against the selected chain's real PoolManager and IMD is still owed. docs/REVIEW.md records the implementer's self-review and the independent review's findings E1-E10 with dispositions; the protected floor suites pass with flags 0x20CC. Supply split and liquidity (90% to the pool single-sided, 0% to the requester, no IMD or ETH added) are launch-policy inputs, not set here.
